{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
customer_segment_conversion = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
customer_segment_conversion.columns = ['customer_segment', 'conversion_rate']

# Print the full conversion rate table to show all values
print(customer_segment_conversion)

# Find and print the segment with the highest conversion rate
top_segment = customer_segment_conversion.loc[customer_segment_conversion['conversion_rate'].idxmax()]['customer_segment']
print(f"Top segment: {top_segment}")"}
